turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have twenty minutes, so let's not waste them. Why did my son find out about a zero from his phone, in the middle of class?
Thanks for coming in. I owe you an apology: the zero went in before I called you.
Okay. Now, on what basis was it entered, and who decided?
I am withdrawing the zero today. Owen does a private supervised rewrite at lunch. Nothing goes on his record. I will email you that tonight.
Okay. I'm writing that down. The zero comes out of the gradebook today, not tonight in an email. If it's coming off, why does Owen owe a rewrite at all, and what mark does it replace?
Here it is in writing, signed.
Give it here. I'm reading every line before I say anything else. You still haven't told me what the rewrite replaces.
Thank you for your time, Ms. Kalinowski.
We're not finished, Hale. I've read what you handed me, and you still haven't told me what the rewrite's mark replaces, or when the zero comes out of the gradebook. Answer both before I stand up.
I'm still in this chair, Hale. Two answers: what the rewrite replaces, and when the zero comes out of the gradebook. Walk out without them and my next stop is the principal's office.
